Is detailed Batch 2 series mein CCS LTC Rules 7 se 11 aur unse jude government instructions dekhenge. Part 1 Rule 7 ke pehle provisions par hai.
Rule 7 sub rule 1, Rule 1 sub rule 3 ki civil posts aur contract wali categories ka zikr karta hai. Inke liye ek saal continuous Central Government service ki condition hai.
Ek saal ka test employee ya family member ki journey ki date par lagta hai, application ki date par nahi. Contract aur doosri applicable categories ke liye Rule 2 bhi check karein.
Rule 7 sub rule 2 ke mutabiq LTC kisi bhi leave ke dauraan admissible hai, including casual leave aur special casual leave.
Guidelines child care leave aur study leave ka bhi zikr karti hain. Sirf weekend ya holiday par bina due aur admissible leave ke employee ki LTC nahi hoti.
FAQ question 26 ke mutabiq, agar sirf family travel kar rahi ho aur employee nahi, to employee ko leave lene ki zaroorat nahi hai.
Rule 7 Note 1: vacation department mein vacation ko regular leave maana jaata hai. Railway accommodation ki class journey ke samay normal entitlement ke hisaab se hoti hai.
Journey se pehle Controlling Officer ko inform karein aur actual journey ka evidence dein. Service record mein leave ke saath LTC availment ka fact bhi record kiya jaata hai.
Technical resignation ke baad LTC entitlement ki continuity aur pehli appointment se fresh recruit treatment ke liye relevant original order aur uski conditions verify karein.
Declared hometown India ke bahar ho aur Controlling Officer satisfy ho, to guidelines limited Government assistance ka zikr karti hain. Exact limit original applicable order se verify karein.
